description: Source code for Kubernetes YAML manipulation, including functions and types for clearing annotations, setting metadata, and managing labels and annotations within Kubernetes resource YAMLs.

classes.name: k8sMetaSetter
classes.description: Sets a metadata key-value pair, creating metadata if necessary.

classes.name: AnnotationSetter
classes.description: Sets an annotation at metadata.annotations, creating annotations if necessary.

classes.name: AnnotationGetter
classes.description: Retrieves an annotation value from metadata.annotations.

classes.name: LabelSetter
classes.description: Sets a label at metadata.labels, creating labels if necessary.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Applies filtering logic to RNode for various operations like clearing or setting annotations/metadata.

methods.name: ClearAnnotation
methods.description: Creates an AnnotationClearer to remove a specific annotation.

methods.name: ClearEmptyAnnotations
methods.description: Clears empty annotations and metadata if they are null or empty.

methods.name: SetK8sName
methods.description: Creates a k8sMetaSetter to set the resource name.

methods.name: SetK8sNamespace
methods.description: Creates a k8sMetaSetter to set the resource namespace.

methods.name: SetAnnotation
methods.description: Creates an AnnotationSetter to add or update an annotation.

methods.name: GetAnnotation
methods.description: Creates an AnnotationGetter to retrieve an annotation value.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Creates a LabelSetter to add or update a label.
